name: UGC 2698 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 2698, a compact early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc2698-hubble
story: UGC 2698 is a small, dense galaxy that may be a relic of the early universe, and a disk of gas whirls around the supermassive black hole at its heart.

claims.text: UGC 2698 is a local compact galaxy

A circumnuclear gas disk rotates around the center of UGC 2698

Hubble program 13416 imaged UGC 2698 to constrain its black hole mass
